steps: 1. Start a Chaos Wastes run and acquire **Stromfels' Retribution** or **Righteous Finesse**. Complete at least one boon roll so the automatic cooldown repair has run.
2. Perform several successful timed blocks closer together than the boon's stated cooldown. Watch whether each timed block triggers the effect.
3. Repeat with the other boon when available: Stromfels' Retribution should produce its lightning strike; Righteous Finesse should produce its knockback and Skull-boon refresh.
4. Run `/ct_regression_test`, exit normally, and attach the newest complete log. State which boon or boons were exercised and whether any consecutive parry failed to trigger.
assertions: Consecutive successful timed blocks are not suppressed by the old cooldown. Neither boon crashes. The registered cooldown-template checks pass; missing/unreadable templates or a remaining nonzero duration are failures, not a silent pass.
After one boon roll read boon_skulls_03_cooldown and every static_blade cooldown template: all durations 0; then two scripted timed blocks both proc.
